source_contract: ObjectClass::InsertDefaults allocates each default class, looks it up with NewGRFClass::Get and sets its name; the class registry stays a process-wide Rust static that the game-state mutex serializes.
reason: Writing the name through the class pointer that the shared NewGRFClass::Get port returns is a raw-pointer store, as in the three other registries' InsertDefaults ports, whose modules allow unsafe code; newgrf_object.rs denies it outside item-scoped allows.
retirement_condition: When newgrf_class.rs's pass gives the registry a safe class accessor, or newgrf_object.rs's pass places the body where unsafe code is allowed.
